requirement: As a user, I want to add an item to my shopping list so that I can track things I need to buy.

test_cases.title: Add item with all fields populated
steps: Given I am logged in and viewing a category
When I click "+ Add item" and fill in name, brand, unit price, and quantity
And I click "Save item"
Then the new item appears in the item list with the values I entered

test_cases.title: Add item with only the required name field
steps: Given I am viewing a category
When I click "+ Add item" and fill in only the item name
And I click "Save item"
Then the item is saved successfully with default values for optional fields

test_cases.title: Attempt to add an item with an empty name
steps: Given I am viewing a category
When I click "+ Add item" and leave the name field blank
And I click "Save item"
Then I see a validation message and the item is not created

requirement: As a user, I want to edit an existing item's price so that my spending totals stay accurate.

test_cases.title: Edit an item's unit price successfully
steps: Given an item exists with a known unit price
When I open the item's edit form and change the unit price
And I click "Save"
Then the item row reflects the new unit price and updated total

test_cases.title: Cancel an edit without saving
steps: Given an item exists with a known unit price
When I open the item's edit form, change the price, and close without saving
Then the item retains its original price

requirement: As a user, I want to delete an item from my list so that I can remove things I no longer need.

test_cases.title: Delete an item and confirm removal
steps: Given an item exists in a category
When I click the delete icon on that item and confirm
Then the item no longer appears in the list

test_cases.title: Cancel a delete action
steps: Given an item exists in a category
When I click the delete icon but cancel the confirmation
Then the item is still present in the list

requirement: As a user, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my shopping lists.

test_cases.title: Log in with valid credentials
steps: Given I am on the login page
When I enter a valid email and password and click "Sign in"
Then I am redirected to my dashboard

test_cases.title: Attempt login with an incorrect password
steps: Given I am on the login page
When I enter a valid email with an incorrect password and click "Sign in"
Then I see an authentication error and remain on the login page

requirement: As a user, I want to search my items so that I can quickly find something without scrolling.

test_cases.title: Search returns matching items
steps: Given a category contains multiple items
When I type a partial item name into the search box
Then only items matching that text are shown

test_cases.title: Search with no matching results
steps: Given a category contains items
When I search for text that matches no item
Then I see an empty state message instead of a stale list
